name: Louis Borno
contribution: A lawyer and Haitian politician who served as President of Haiti from 1922 to 1930 during the period of the American occupation of Haiti.

checks.lead: Eustache Antoine François Joseph Louis Borno (French pronunciation: [østaʃ ɑ̃twan fʁɑ̃swa ʒozɛf lwi bɔʁno]; September 20, 1865 – July 29, 1942) was a lawyer and Haitian politician who served as President of Haiti from 1922 to 1930 during the period of the American occupation of Haiti (1915–34).
